text:
elaine: Heads-up — planning to propose a small API change for runtime config applies. goal: stop surprise diffs reaching routers during big rollouts.

jay: tl;dr on the change?

elaine: Add a /configs/apply-preview endpoint that runs validation + telemetry dry-run and returns a sampling report before the actual apply. No auto-commits.

tomas: Love the idea. how is sampling decided? full-tenant shadow or percentage?

elaine: Default to 1% of traffic for shadow, with an optional "cohort" field to pin to a customer segment. ops can bump. also include tokenized route keys.

kai: where does the telemetry land? we need per-key regressions for latency, error-rate, and token-cost.

elaine: Preview returns a signed report with metrics and a pass/fail heuristic. format: JSON with measurements + delta vs baseline. example: 
```
{
  "cohort": "1%",
  "latency_p95_delta_ms": 12,
  "error_rate_delta_pp": 0.02,
  "cost_delta_per_1k_tokens": 1.4
}
```

jay: we should include a compact score so console UI can show green/yellow/red without parsing numbers.

elaine: yep — score 0-100. + raw. UI can set thresholds.

kai: two concerns: (1) privacy for customer payloads in preview telemetry; (2) runtime overhead when we fork traffic to shadow.

elaine: (1) we do sampling + PII redaction + k-anon masks. preview contract includes a flag specifying redaction level. (2) we'll route shadow to dead-letter pool on dedicated capacity to avoid impacting real path. ops budget must approve heavy previews.

tomas: how about config apply API semantics? atomic apply vs staged? we still need a canary window for safety.

elaine: plan: /apply-preview (dry-run) -> signed-report -> operator review -> /configs/commit with optional staged-rollout params (rate, region, cohorts). commit can be resumed or paused.

jay: need audit trail: who triggered preview, who approved commit, git sha of config. Tie into existing config-ledger.

elaine: yes — the report includes commit metadata and we append an immutable ledger entry with operator id and tokens used for preview.

devops-bot: deploy-checklist: preview-api tests green, telemetry-pipeline schema updated, RBAC scopes (configs.preview, configs.commit) added.

kai: also require a UI affordance: preview -> review -> approve/rollback buttons + link to raw report. product wants a quick diff view for routing changes.

elaine: UI we can drive with the compact score + change diff for affected routes/quotas. will wire to console.

tomas: small API nit: make preview idempotent and return a stable preview_id so we can re-fetch the same report later even if baseline changes.

elaine: agreed — preview_id is cryptographic hash of config + sampling seed.

jay: one more: SLIs. if preview shows >5ms p95 or >0.5% error bump, auto-suggest rollback and block auto-commit until manual override.

elaine: yup. default heuristics in server, but org admins can tune.

kai: sounds good. i'll sketch telemetry schema and redaction knobs. can we get an RFC by EOD tomorrow?

elaine: i'll draft RFC and small PoC endpoint. thanks all. :raised_hands:
